newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks pare losses at close after short day.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks pare losses at close after short day.

text.p: Thai stocks closed 2.20 percent lower on Monday after the market opened for an abbreviated session in the late afternoon following computer problems which were blamed for a halt in trading for most of the day.
A support fund, set up by banks, was active and helped pare heavy losses which drove the index down 4.98 percent shortly after trade resumed at 0915 GMT.

The SET Index ended down 12.77 points at 568.36. The SET 50 ended 1.35 points, or 3.18 percent lower at 41.14. Trade worth 1.59 billion, was brisk in a total of 33 minutes of trading that took place on Monday.
